top_target_buyers.fit_rationale: Family-owned since 1947, offers complete meat processing with custom cut options. Fresh meat counter, deli, and produce section. Already serves the local farm community and processes beef, pork, and chicken. The custom cut sheet tool would streamline their customer ordering process and reduce manual paperwork.
top_target_buyers.outreach_angle: Present as digital transformation partner for their custom processing workflow. Emphasize reducing paperwork for cut sheets and modernizing the customer ordering experience.
top_target_buyers.company_history: Founded 1947 by Rose and Jerry Lukes. Ozzie Nelson took over in early 1970s. Mark and Chris Kovacic became owners in 1988. Chris Kovacic passed away June 21, 2020. Mark Kovacic is now sole owner.

top_target_buyers.fit_rationale: USDA inspected whole animal butcher shop specializing in charcuterie and salumi. Ohio Proud member since 2019. Produces nitrate-free salamis, hams, and bacons. Already sells to fine dining establishments in Ashtabula Harbor. A digital cut sheet tool would help them manage custom orders from restaurants and retail customers more efficiently.
top_target_buyers.outreach_angle: Emphasize professional ordering system for their restaurant wholesale clients. Highlight how digital cut sheets can streamline their custom charcuterie orders and improve customer experience.
top_target_buyers.company_history: Founded 2016 by Chef Nate Fagnilli (formerly of Crosswinds Grille) and wife Kristen. Na*Kyrsie (pronounced 'Na-Ker-See') is a portmanteau of their names. Specializes in dry-aged steaks, nitrate-free artisan salamis, bacon, and hams. Supplies local fine dining establishments.
